title: Países do Mundo / Countries of the World (pt-BR)
subtitle: 167 countries x 53 fields: ISO codes, PT names, languages, currencies, locales
description:
**Países do mundo** com códigos, nomes em português, idiomas, moedas, fusos horários e formatos regionais. **Countries of the world** with ISO codes, Portuguese names, languages, currencies, time zones and locale formats.

167 countries and territories × 53 typed columns, built for software that needs to localise content: which locale to use, how to format dates and numbers, which currency and calling code apply, which day starts the week, whether text runs right to left.

## What is inside

- **Codes:** ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, alpha-3 and numeric, IOC code, calling code, ccTLDs (including internationalised ones).
- **Names:** Brazilian Portuguese common and official names, English official name, native name, flag emoji, capital, demonym.
- **Geography:** UN M49 region and sub-region, approximate centre, area, population (circa 2024–2025), density, landlocked flag, land borders.
- **Politics:** independence, UN membership, system of government, form of state, blocs (EU, Mercosur, NATO, G20…).
- **Languages and locale:** main language, official languages, BCP 47 locale, writing direction, first day of the week, 12/24h clock, short date pattern, decimal and thousands separators, measurement system, paper size.
- **Time:** IANA time zones, number of UTC offsets, daylight saving time.
- **Money:** ISO 4217 codes, names in Portuguese, symbols.

## Files

- `paises.csv`: UTF-8, comma separated; lists inside a cell use `|`.
- `paises.parquet`: same data with types (booleans, integers, floats).
- `paises.json`: array of records.

## Origin and quality

The country list comes from a 2021 App Store catalog (167 storefronts). It was enriched following ISO, UN M49, Unicode CLDR and IANA standards, then validated: ISO codes, border symmetry, density, locale consistency. Eighteen classes of errors found in the original data were fixed and documented.

Full data dictionary, methodology, quality report and the build/validation scripts: **https://github.com/CaiqueDourado/paises-do-mundo-ptbr**

License: CC BY 4.0. Author: Caique Dourado.

resources.description: One row per country or territory (167): codes, names in Portuguese and English, regions, borders, currencies, languages, locale formats and time zones.

fields.name: iso2
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. Primary key.

fields.name: iso3
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code.

fields.name: iso_numeric
fields.description: ISO 3166-1 numeric code, kept as text to preserve leading zeros ("024").

fields.name: ioc_code
fields.description: International Olympic Committee code. Empty for territories without a National Olympic Committee.

fields.name: name_en
fields.description: Short English name as used by the Apple App Store storefront list (e.g. "Swaziland", "Korea, Republic Of").

fields.name: name_pt
fields.description: Common name in Brazilian Portuguese.

fields.name: official_name_pt
fields.description: Official long name in Portuguese.

fields.name: official_name_en
fields.description: Official long name in English.

fields.name: native_name
fields.description: Name in the main official language and script.

fields.name: flag_emoji
fields.description: Flag emoji (pair of regional indicator symbols).

fields.name: capital_en
fields.description: Capital city in English. Several capitals are separated by ", " (South Africa). Empty for Hong Kong and Macau.

fields.name: continent_group
fields.description: Grouping used on the 919Apps home page (Africa, America, Asia, Caribbean, Europe, Oceania…). Kept for compatibility; prefer un_region for analysis.

fields.name: continent_subgroup
fields.description: Sub-grouping used on the 919Apps home page (South America, Eastern Europe…).

fields.name: un_region
fields.description: UN M49 region: Africa, Americas, Asia, Europe, Oceania.

fields.name: un_subregion
fields.description: UN M49 sub-region (e.g. Western Africa, South America).

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Approximate latitude of the country's centre, decimal degrees.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Approximate longitude of the country's centre, decimal degrees.

fields.name: area_km2
fields.description: Total area in km².

fields.name: population_millions
fields.description: Approximate population in millions, circa 2024–2025.

fields.name: density_per_km2
fields.description: Approximate inhabitants per km² (population / area).

fields.name: landlocked
fields.description: True when the country has no sea coast.

fields.name: borders_iso3
fields.description: Land neighbours as ISO alpha-3 codes separated by "|". May reference countries outside this dataset; UNK = Kosovo.

fields.name: border_count
fields.description: Number of land neighbours (length of borders_iso3).

fields.name: independent
fields.description: True for sovereign states; False for dependencies and special administrative regions.

fields.name: un_member
fields.description: True for UN member states.

fields.name: government_pt
fields.description: System of government, in Portuguese.

fields.name: state_form_pt
fields.description: Form of state (Unitário, Federal, Dependência…), in Portuguese.

fields.name: memberships_pt
fields.description: Blocs and organisations, separated by "|" (UE, Mercosul, OTAN, G20…).

fields.name: currency_codes
fields.description: ISO 4217 currency codes in use, separated by "|".

fields.name: currency_names_pt
fields.description: Currency names in Portuguese, same order as currency_codes.

fields.name: currency_symbols
fields.description: Local currency symbols, same order as currency_codes.

fields.name: primary_language
fields.description: Main language, ISO 639-1 (or 639-3 when there is no two-letter code).

fields.name: official_languages_iso639_2
fields.description: Official languages as ISO 639-2/B codes, separated by "|".

fields.name: official_languages_en
fields.description: Official and recognised languages, English names, separated by "|".

fields.name: locale
fields.description: Suggested BCP 47 locale for the country (pt-BR, zh-Hant-HK…).

fields.name: writing_direction
fields.description: Direction of the main language: ltr or rtl.

fields.name: has_rtl_official_language
fields.description: True when at least one official language is written right-to-left.

fields.name: timezones_iana
fields.description: IANA time zone identifiers, separated by "|".

fields.name: utc_offset_count
fields.description: Number of distinct standard UTC offsets (not the number of IANA zones).

fields.name: utc_offsets
fields.description: Standard offset, or range "UTC-05:00 a UTC-02:00" when there are several.

fields.name: observes_dst
fields.description: True when daylight saving time is observed in at least part of the country.

fields.name: calling_code
fields.description: International calling code (+55).

fields.name: cctld
fields.description: Country code top-level domains, including internationalised ones, separated by "|".

fields.name: demonym_en
fields.description: Demonym in English.

fields.name: driving_side
fields.description: Side of the road traffic drives on: right or left.

fields.name: first_day_of_week
fields.description: First day of the week in calendars: monday, sunday or saturday.

fields.name: time_format
fields.description: Usual clock: 12h or 24h.

fields.name: short_date_pattern
fields.description: Short date pattern for the locale (dd/MM/y).

fields.name: decimal_separator
fields.description: Decimal separator: comma or period.

fields.name: grouping_separator
fields.description: Thousands separator: comma, period, space (U+00A0), narrow_space (U+202F) or apostrophe (’).

fields.name: measurement_system
fields.description: metric, metric_with_imperial, us_customary_and_metric or us_customary.

fields.name: paper_size
fields.description: Default paper size: A4 or Letter.

fields.name: notes_pt
fields.description: Notes in Portuguese (political status, geography, recent changes).
